claims.quote: In infectious disease, anticipated regulatory filings for Islachivir plus Lenacapivir, the potential first once-weekly oral two-drug treatment regimen for HIV.

claims.speaker: Management
claims.quote: And finally, in oncology, the potential approval of SAC-TMT in endometrial cancer and additional phase 3 readouts.

claims.speaker: Management
claims.quote: For 2027, we see it as another year of investment, as we invest behind our expansive pipeline and our new product launches to drive long-term growth.

claims.speaker: Management
claims.quote: Specifically in 2027, we expect moderate top line growth.

claims.speaker: Management
claims.quote: We do expect Keytruda to continue to be an important contributor to our overall revenues, although we do see growth moderating.

claims.speaker: Management
claims.quote: While we also expect headwinds to price in our XUS market, and we are watching the policy dynamics in Germany.

claims.speaker: Management
claims.quote: 2026 of approximately $250 million that will unwind in 2027.

claims.speaker: Management
claims.quote: Growth margin will increase given the roll-off of a royalty on Keytruda.

claims.speaker: Management
claims.quote: As you've noted, we expect expenses to increase because we are fully investing behind our strong pipeline as well as our launches.

claims.speaker: Management
claims.quote: And we do expect slightly higher interest expense and a slightly higher tax rate.

claims.speaker: Management
claims.quote: Now, as we look at that, we see the Keytruda LOE as really more of a hill on the overall revenues of our company as we will, in short order, then return to strong growth.

claims.speaker: Management
claims.quote: And we do expect, as I've noted, a shallow dip in revenues in the initial period post the price setting through IRA and the LOE, but to quickly return to growth.
